instruction: I need help setting up a text generation environment for the Transformers library. Please clone the repository from 'https://github.com/huggingface/transformers' into /home/user and install the necessary dependencies following their quick start guide.

metadata.explanation: Task variation testing Hugging Face Transformers library setup. Evaluator verifies that the transformers module can be imported and version can be printed without import errors. The check_include_exclude metric ensures no error strings appear in output.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires cloning repository to /home/user directory, but evaluator does not verify clone location or directory existence
Evaluator only checks if transformers module can be imported without errors, which would pass even if repository was never cloned
Missing verification: No check for /home/user/transformers/ directory existence
Installation method ambiguity: Task would pass with 'pip install transformers' alone, bypassing the repository cloning requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to check if /home/user/transformers directory exists (e.g., vm_command to run 'test -d /home/user/transformers && echo exists')
Add additional evaluator step to verify repository was cloned to correct location before checking import
Consider using composite evaluation: (1) directory exists at /home/user/transformers AND (2) transformers imports successfully
Alternatively, simplify instruction to only require 'install transformers library' if clone location is not critical
